scope: Crowdsourced human-assistant conversations; prevalence-only analysis, not production API traffic
privacy: Raw prompt text and user IDs are processed locally and never exported in the audit summary.
analysis: Select first-level prompter messages with no parent, sort chronologically, take first 5000 eligible roots, and report raw exact plus NFKC/casefold/whitespace-folded repeats globally and within the same source user ID. User IDs are not tenants.
